text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Following the conclusion of the sectoral plan procedure, the applicant concerned is authorised to develop the transmission line project for the specified corridor and initiate the planning approval process.", "gist": "Applicant can proceed with transmission line project after sectoral plan procedure concludes."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Under certain circumstances, it is possible to waive the implementation of a sectoral plan procedure.", "gist": "Sectoral plan procedure can be waived under specific conditions."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "SFOE", "gist": "Swiss Federal Office of Energy (or similar authority)"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "Here the SFOE decides on any exemptions from the sectoral plan requirement.", "gist": "SFOE is responsible for deciding on sectoral plan exemptions."}]}
